name: Green Banana Stew
description: Unripe bananas stewed with coconut milk, sugar, and spices.
directions: Sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper in olive oil..
Add green bananas and stir well.
Pour in broth, tomatoes, and seasonings.
Simmer for 30–45 minutes until tender.
Adjust taste, garnish, and serve hot.

name: Green Banana Fries
description: Fried unripe banana slices, a savory alternative to fries.
directions: Mash bananas in a bowl.
Mix butter and sugar until creamy.
Add eggs and mashed bananas; mix well.
Stir in flour and baking soda.
Pour mixture into a greased loaf pan and bake at 180°C for 50–60 minutes.

name: Chocolate covered bananas
description: Frozen bananas dipped in chocolate, topped with nuts or sprinkles.
directions: Insert sticks into banana halves and freeze for 15 minutes.
Melt chocolate with coconut oil until smooth.
Dip bananas in chocolate and add toppings.
Freeze again for 30 minutes before serving

name: Banana Oatmeal Pancake
description: Mashed bananas mixed with oats, cooked into flat round pancakes.
directions: Blend all ingredients (except oil and add-ins) until smooth.
Stir in add-ins if desired.
Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat. Pour ⅓ cup batter and cook until bubbles form.
Flip and cook for 1 more minute. Serve warm with toppings.

name: Maruya
description: Sliced bananas coated in batter, deep-fried until golden brown.
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon or nutmeg. Add water and stir until smooth.
Peel and slice saba bananas.
Dip in batter and fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Drain excess oil and serve warm.

name: Banana Bread
description: Sweet bread or cake made from mashed bananas.
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C)
Mix flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda.
In another bowl, combine mashed bananas, eggs, oil, and vanilla.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until blended.
Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake for about 1 hour.
Cool, slice and serve.

name: Nilupak
description: Mashed bananas with butter, sugar, and coconut, a sweet delicacy.
directions: Peel 15 saba bananas and place in a pot with water.
Boil over high heat for 12–15 minutes or until tender.
Drain and cool slightly.
Mash until smooth
Add grated coconut, brown sugar, and vanilla; mix well.
Warm banana leaves until soft and shiny, then arrange on a plate.
Spread, shape, brush with butter, cut, and serve.

name: Pinakro
description: Mashed bananas with butter, sugar, and coconut, a sweet delicacy.
directions: Peel and slice the bananas into two inch pieces
Combine with coconut milk, salt, and half the sugar in a pot
Cook over medium heat until boiling
Add coconut cream and remaining sugar
Simmer until bananas are tender and sauce thickens

name: Bananacue
description: A popular Filipino snack of caramelized fried saba bananas.
directions: Peel saba bananas and slice diagonally into 1-inch pieces.
Heat enough oil in a pan over medium heat for deep frying.
Fry banana slices until golden brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Sprinkle brown sugar on top. (Optional)
Serve hot and enjoy

name: Turon
description: Crispy lumpia filled with banana and jackfruit, glazed in rich caramel.
directions: Slice bananas lengthwise into four pieces.
Peel wrappers and keep covered with a damp towel.
Place the banana on the wrapper corner, fold sides, and roll.
Seal edge with water or cornstarch.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Caramelize sugar and coat or drizzle over turon.

name: Pickled Mango
description: Tangy and salty snack made by soaking unripe mango slices in a vinegar-based brine.
directions: Prepare clean and sterilized jar and lids
Peel unripe mangoes and cut them into ⅓ inch thick slivers.
Arrange sliced mangoes into the sterilized jar and add chilli pepper.
In a saucepan over high heat, combine the vinegar, sugar, and salt. Boil and stir until the sugar and salt dissolve
Pour the mixture into the jars, leaving a ½-inch gap from the top. Gently tap the jars to remove air bubbles.
Cover the jars with lids, let them cool, and refrigerate for 48 hours before consuming.

name: Raw Mango
directions: Wash the fruit and consume by itself.

name: Mango Jelly
description: Delicious and refreshing dessert made from mango juice, gelatin, sugar, and water.
ingredients: 2 packs unchilled all-purpose cream 250 ml per pack
2 jars drained nata de coco 340g each.
2 big ripe mangoes cut into cubes and chilled
directions: Boil mango jelly powder with water and sugar, then pour into molds. Let it set and cut into cubes.
Boil 4 cups of water, add tapioca pearls, cover, and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until translucent.
In a large bowl, combine condensed milk, all-purpose cream, nata de coco, tapioca pearls, mango jelly, and mango cubes
Refrigerate until cold and serve.

name: Mango Salad
description: Concoction of ripe mangoes, tomatoes and white onions using sauteed bagoong.
directions: Combine mangoes, tomatoes, onion, and cilantro in a bowl.
Whisk together dressing ingredients until well blended.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently.
Serve immediately on its own or with a main dish.

name: Mango Pudding
description: A luscious blend of ripe mangoes and silky pudding.
directions: Peel, pit and dice mangoes and toss them into blender or food processor for at least 1 minute.
In a large bowl,  mix gelatin powder with cold water and let it thicken.
In the gelatin mixture, add sugar, coconut milk, and mango purée to the gelatin. Heat gently, stirring until fully dissolved and smooth.
Stir in flour and baking soda.
Pour into molds or serving bowls, smooth the top, and refrigerate at least 6 hours to set. Top with evaporated milk and serve.

name: Mango Cheesecake
description: A twist on classic cheesecake, enhanced with mango jelly or tropical mango flavor.
directions: Crush the biscuits into fine crumbs using food processors or by using plastic bag and rolling pan.
Add melted butter and sugar, then mix well until crumbs look like wet sand.
Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a springform pan.
Chill in the fridge.
Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in a small bowl and let sit for 5 minutes to thicken.
Microwave for about 15 seconds at a time until gelatin fully melts and let it sit cool slightly.
Blend the mangoes until smooth. Save ¾ cups of the puree for the topping later.
In a large bowl, combine cream cheese, sugar, whipping cream, mango puree, and melted gelatin.
Beat or blend until smooth and creamy, then pour the mixture into the crust, spread evenly, and chill for at least 3 hours or until firm.
In  a small bowl, sprinkle ¾ tsp gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let it sit for 5 mins.
Microwave until melted then let it cool for a few minutes.
Mix the saved ¾ cups mango puree and lemon juice in a bowl.
Add the melted gelatin and stir well.
Pour this mango mixture over the chilled cheesecake, spread evenly and chill for at least 12 hours until fully set.

name: Fried Green Tomato
description: Tart green tomatoes coated w/ panko and fried perfectly.
ingredients: 4 green tomatoes, cut into ¼-inch slices
directions: Season tomato slices with salt and pepper.
Prepare three coatings: flour, salt, pepper, buttermilk, cornmeal, paprika, salt,pepepr, and cayenne
Dredge tomatoes in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat with cornmeal mix. Let rest for 10–15 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F (175°C) and fry tomatoes for 2–3 minutes until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve with Cajun-Ranch sauce, if desired.

name: Tilapia with Green Tomato Tapenade
description: This fruit can be consumed raw or cooked
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
directions: Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in diced tomatoes, green tomatoes, capers, basil, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors combine, about 5 minutes.
Season tilapia fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add tilapia fillets; cook until flesh flakes easily with a fork, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a serving platter.
Pour lemon juice into the skillet; swirl to pick up browned bits off the bottom of the skillet, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Pour over fillets.
Spoon tomato mixture over fillets before serving.

name: Sauteed Tomatoes
description: A pinoy version of scrambled egg with tomatoes and onions.
directions: Mash bananas in a bowl.
Mix butter and sugar until creamy.
Add eggs and mashed bananas; mix well.
Stir in flour and baking soda.
Pour mixture into a greased loaf pan and bake at 180°C for 50–60 minutes.

name: Tomato Sauce
description: A thick sauce made with tomatoes, oil, and herbs, often served with pasta
ingredients: 4 lb plum tomatoes (or two 28-oz cans whole peeled plum tomatoes)
directions: For fresh tomatoes: Score an “X” on each, blanch in boiling water for 1–2 minutes, cool in ice water, and remove skins.
Chop tomatoes with their juices and place in a large pot.
Add butter, olive oil, onions, garlic, salt, and sugar. Bring to a gentle boil.
Lower heat and simmer uncovered for 1½–2½ hours, stirring occasionally and mashing large pieces.
Remove onions. Add basil before serving and adjust seasoning as needed.

name: Tomato Juice
description: A healthy beverage made from the juice of fresh tomatoes
ingredients: 4 lb plum tomatoes (or two 28-oz cans whole peeled plum tomatoes)
directions: Mash bananas in a bowl.
Mix butter and sugar until creamy.
Add eggs and mashed bananas; mix well.
Stir in flour and baking soda.
Pour mixture into a greased loaf pan and bake at 180°C for 50–60 minutes.

name: Salsa
description: Homemade salsa with a hint of spice is the perfect condiment for snacking.
directions: Chop the tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and garlic.
Place all ingredients in a bowl.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Mix well and let sit before serving.
